### `jwt` matcher

JWT match, value is a STRING of JSON text describing the expected {"header":..,"payload":..} subset (same rules as jsonpartial). doMatch chains the decoded composite. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** transforms/extracts a value for the next chained matcher (not a re-test of the same input).
